comment: ADR-060 §2 — pinned custom-node allowlist for the comfyui adapter. A workflow referencing a class_type outside core_class_types AND outside a pinned custom_nodes entry is HARD-REFUSED (exit 7, named node). There is no bypass flag by design. Every custom_nodes entry pins repo + git commit SHA and carries risk_tier (high = monthly audit, low = quarterly). Kill-switch: >2 CVSS>=7 CVEs in 90 days removes the entry and deprecates dependent templates.
